## About
Accel Automotive was started by John Di lanni, Brian Schoener and Leroy Ward. They had worked for new car dealerships and wanted to do it their own way, with more integrity and expertise than the usual garage and an atmosphere where you deal directly with the owners. Kala Coleman is our service manager.
We're a complete car care facility. We use factory level repair information from Alldata, a worldwide network of technicians through iATN, and our training as ASE Certified Master Technicians to find what's wrong and fix it. Our list runs from Acura and Alfa Romeo to Volkswagen and Volvo, plus classics like Austin Healey, MG and Triumph.
We're on Linden Street in Waltham, close to public transportation. We're rated 5 stars from 52 Google reviews. Call us for questions and advice. We will take the time to speak with you.

## Services
- Diagnostics: Cars keep getting more complicated. We use Alldata, iATN and our ASE certification to track down the problem. One reviewer said John diagnosed a problem that had stumped their Honda dealer.
- Maintenance: We follow the factory maintenance schedules to keep a good car adding miles. Service reminders are available on request.
- Restoration and special projects: Classic and special interest cars need an extra measure of expertise. We help keep classic and custom cars cruising all summer.
- Car & Motorcycle Storage: A heated and secure spot for your car or motorcycle.
- Pre-purchase vehicle inspections: Have us look over a car before you buy it.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: Appointments are recommended. One reviewer found us booked out a few weeks, so it helps to call ahead.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 7:30 to 5:30, and closed on weekends. After-hours drop-off is available.

Q: What cards do you accept?
A: We accept VISA, MasterCard and Discover.

Q: Do you work on European cars?
A: Yes. Our list includes Alfa Romeo, Audi, BMW, Jaguar, Land Rover, Mercedes Benz, Porsche, Saab, Volkswagen and Volvo. One reviewer brings in a VW GTI and said we have a niche with European cars.

Q: Do you have a referral offer?
A: Refer a qualifying customer and your next oil change is on us.
